Unauthenticated adjacent command execution via HA
Summary
A missing authentication for critical function vulnerability [CWE-306] in FortiOS may allow an unauthenticated attacker with HA FGSP + standalone-config-sync, or autoscale to execute command as super admin via crafted HA packets.
Version
Affected
Solution
FortiOS 8.0
8.0.0
Upgrade to 8.0.1 or above
FortiOS 7.6
7.6.0 through 7.6.7
Upgrade to 7.6.8 or above
FortiOS 7.4
7.4.0 through 7.4.12
Upgrade to 7.4.13 or above
FortiOS 7.2
7.2.0 through 7.2.13
Upgrade to 7.2.14 or above
FortiOS 7.0
7.0 all versions
Migrate to a fixed release
Follow the recommended upgrade path using our tool at: https://docs.fortinet.com/upgrade-tool
FortiGate HA clusters running FGCP (both active-passive and active-active) are also affected on vulnerable pre-fix versions. However, exploitation requires HA-segment adjacent attack vector.
In environments where the HA L2 segment is not fully trusted, on fixed versions, enable the following configuration:
FGCP HA (a-p or a-a):config system ha
set password
set encryption enable
set authentication enable
end
Standalone-config-sync without FGSP peers:
Same as above
Standalone-config-sync with FGSP peers:
Same as above andconfig system standalone-cluster
set encryption enable
set psksecret
end
Autoscale:config system autoscale
set psksecret
end
Virtual Patch named "FG-VD-61445.0day." is available in FMWP db update 26.082
Acknowledgement
Internally discovered and reported by Theo Leleu of Fortinet Product Security team with the use of Frontier AI model: Claude Mythos.
